method: Searched YouTube for every standout track using artist and song title. Preferred artist, label, VEVO, or distributor-provided Topic uploads, using individual studio recordings rather than live performances, reactions, covers, instrumentals, or full albums. Inspected watch-page video metadata and playability status for all 92 selected recordings. One unresolved track uses a clearly labeled search fallback. No API keys or runtime requests are required by the site.
availability_note: YouTube returned OK for these recordings when checked. This is not an audio audit or a guarantee of future availability, embedding permission, or playback in every region.
